plan.title: Live RFQ Click Here Order Details

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required withdrawal visibility setting.
Allow withdrawal during the live submission period as required.
Enable vendor masking for everyone as required by the scenario.
Activate the control whose resulting screen is being tested.
Verify that the Order Details view opened.
Verify the expected edit control is present.
Verify the event title field is shown.
Verify the location field is shown.
